lines: U7 static admin audit is committed as 6b7fcb7 on track/u-static-admin: plans/ui-overhaul/consistency-admin.md (928 lines, docs only, base d4c817e). U7 is claimed on this track, with evidence record b8f72dda (git diff --check clean).

Scope: all 46 admin routes (22 nav, 21 child, splash/login/not-found), 157 non-test features/admin files (21,138 lines), all 47 src/ui files (3,626 lines). Evidence is STATIC; nothing rendered, no app checks.
Findings: 47 in total (8 high, 23 medium, 16 low), numbered CA-01 to CA-47.
High findings:
- CA-01: no back control anywhere; 21 dead-end child routes.
- CA-02: unknown outcome shown as failure.
- CA-03: retry mints a new key.
- CA-04: held writes dropped on close.
- CA-05: fund archive and money writes have no confirm.
- CA-06: seeded finance role cannot pick an investor.
- CA-07: admin login links to the client-only /password/forgot.
- CA-08: fund publish form blanks months and disclosure.

Pattern counts (grep, features/admin, non-test): Button 153, ButtonLink 25, AdminTable 41 in 36 files, ConfirmDialog 32, Modal 7, useToast 5, LoadMore 25, FilterChip 16, FormField 109, MoneyValue 72, EmptyState 33, AsyncBoundary 56, Alert 143, Section 77, Card 127, PageHeader on 44 routes. Page widths: wide 37, default 6, form 1.

Other counts: 13 h1/manifest title mismatches; 7 ConfirmDialog cancel-label variants; 17 hand-written held-write machines plus useHeldWrite; useUrlFilter on only 2 of 13 filter sets; no literal breakpoint, inline style or raw colour in features/admin.
Correction for later readers: Tailwind xl is 1440 px here (ui/tokens/theme.css:171-175), not 1280. At 1280 only lg applies.
Not determinable from code, for u-audits or runtime checks:
- whether production roles match the seed (CA-06 finance picker, DEC-36 link gaps);
- real table widths at 1280/1440/1920 and the payment-sheet table width;
- whether month and date inputs fall back to text in some browsers;
- server-side caps on unpaged lists (holdings, templates, positions, SIP schedules, contact history);
- whether the server's expectedVersion stops duplicate maturity writes after a lost key;
- the AppUpdate blur-then-click swallow (CA-45);
- whether CA-08 publishes blank durations in practice;
- contrast of fg-faint text and focus rings;
- whether the admin APK ships (so manifest back matters).

Open maintainer questions raised by the doc: does the market-risk/source footnote (CA-47) apply to admin screens; does the maturity payout 'Bank transfer reference' field fall under DEC-14 or rule-18; should the client-values hub admit users.read/read_limited roles (CA-24).
Phase I screens (nominee requests, SIP early exit) were not on main at d4c817e; audit them when they land (DEC-47). Parked DEC-14 screens are inventoried only.
Not landed: the commit waits on track/u-static-admin for the coordinator's land.
